axesMustRemainDistinct: diagnostic severity versus evidence maturity versus feasibility versus workflow versus release

priorityDomains.problem: Different classification axes reuse plain ids such as marine and road.
priorityDomains.migration: Namespaced immutable semantic ids with legacy aliases.

priorityDomains.problem: Units are encoded in field suffixes and several dimensions use incompatible scales.
priorityDomains.migration: QuantityValue nodes with finite numeric value, quantity kind and UCUM-compatible unit.

priorityDomains.problem: Multiple incompatible evidence shapes and incomplete field-level provenance.
priorityDomains.migration: Governed EvidenceRecord metadata and Claim basis; raw/private evidence stays outside portable graphs.

priorityDomains.problem: Pass, review, unproven, approved and released are incorrectly comparable strings.
priorityDomains.migration: Separate diagnostic, evidence, feasibility, workflow and release vocabularies.

priorityDomains.problem: No common system hierarchy and component/material aliases do not always resolve.
priorityDomains.migration: System/pack/module/cell/component/material identities plus hasPart, specifiedBy and selects relations.

priorityDomains.problem: Catalog model, physical host, installation study, policy and generated profile are conflated.
priorityDomains.migration: Separate HostAsset, AssetModel, InstallationStudy, Mission, policy and profile identities.

priorityDomains.problem: No registry links model, solver, run, input, output, trace, test and evidence.
priorityDomains.migration: EngineeringModel, Solver, ModelRun, EngineeringResult, SILRun and HILRun lineage.

priorityDomains.problem: Cell acceptance, charger, source, interface and strategy are implicit maps.
priorityDomains.migration: Charging remains a domain extension under the common ontology; missing marine shore equipment is an unresolved Requirement.

priorityDomains.problem: Barrier, spacer and vent identities are duplicated between catalog and analysis modules.
priorityDomains.migration: Typed safety component, requirement, calculation result, placement and evidence relations.

priorityDomains.problem: Approvals and reports cannot trace conclusions to exact assertions and model runs.
priorityDomains.migration: Version-bound Approval activities and report ontology checksum/trace summary.

privacyBoundary: Do not place raw replay samples, customer documents, local paths, credentials, personal identities or physical asset identifiers in portable ontology graphs.
